summary: The MaintAccountCode module is responsible for managing account codes within an application. It includes a web interface for viewing, adding, editing, and deleting account codes, which are characterized by a code, description, and sort order.
purpose: To provide a user interface for managing account codes, allowing users with adequate permissions to view and modify these codes.

fields.name: ID
fields.description: Unique identifier for each account code.

fields.name: Code
fields.description: The code for the account, input by the user.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: A description of the account code, input by the user.

fields.name: SortOrder
fields.description: Order of the account code in listings, input by the user.

actors.description: Can view and edit all account codes and access all agencies.
Can view and edit account codes for their own agency.

workflows.name: Manage Account Codes
steps: User selects an agency from the dropdown if permissions allow.
User selects an account code type from the dropdown.
User can view the list of account codes associated with the selected agency and type.
User can add a new account code by clicking the add button, filling in details, and saving.
User can edit an existing account code by selecting it, modifying details, and saving.
User can delete an account code by selecting it and confirming deletion.

business_rules: Only System Administrators can access all agencies.
Local Administrators can only access account codes for their own agency.
validations: All fields (Code, Description, SortOrder) must be specified when adding or editing an account code.
SortOrder must be a numeric value.
conditions: Screen is editable only if the user is a System Administrator or a Local Administrator with access to the current agency.
system_behavior: The grid displays account codes based on selected filters and user permissions.
The system checks user permissions to determine if the screen is editable.
dependencies: Uses HSPnet.UI for user interface components.
exceptions: If a user without adequate permissions attempts to access restricted functionalities, the option to edit will not be available.
